name: Soyuz-23
about: Soyuz-23 (1976-100A), a crewed vehicle (7K-TA), launched 1976 Oct 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1976 Oct 15), held fixed
